# Transparent product cutout

Separate background removal from product restyling, with explicit alpha-output settings.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload the shampoo photograph linked below, or your own product photograph.

Source reference images: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/shampoo.webp)

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Extract the product from the input image and isolate it on a fully transparent background.
Output: centered product, crisp silhouette, no halos/fringing.
Preserve product geometry and label legibility exactly.
Add only light polishing. Do not add a solid backdrop, checkerboard, scenery, or shadow.
Do not restyle the product; remove the background and preserve clean alpha transparency.
```

</details>

### Make it your own

Supply your own references, state the role of each, and separate what changes from what must stay.

### Notes

- Inspect alpha edges in an image editor; a displayed preview alone cannot prove transparency.
- Source settings: `size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`, `background="transparent"`, `output_format="png"`.

## 中文

<a href="https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#create-a-transparent-product-cutout"><img src="https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/extract-product-gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.webp" width="640" alt="透明背景产品抠图 — OpenAI — official guide example — 来源结果示例" loading="lazy"></a>

区分去背景与产品改造，并明确透明通道输出参数。

**原始提示词 · 参考图编辑 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 上传下方洗发水照片，或自己的产品照片。

来源参考图: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/shampoo.webp)

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>



```text
从输入图片中提取产品，将它单独放在完全透明的背景上。
输出：产品居中，轮廓清晰，没有光晕或边缘杂色。
精确保留产品几何形状及标签的可读性。
只做轻微润饰。不要添加纯色背景、棋盘格、场景或阴影。
不要改变产品风格；去除背景，保留干净的透明通道。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

提供自己的参考图，说明每张图的用途，并分清要修改与要保留的部分。

### 使用说明

- 在图像编辑器中检查透明通道边缘；仅凭展示预览无法证明透明度。
- 来源参数：`size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`, `background="transparent"`, `output_format="png"`.
